strict_scoring.score_formula: forward fundamental surprise + narrative and expectation shift + supply-chain moat and diffusion + valuation and reaction gap + financial quality and positioning risk + evidence integrity
strict_scoring.interpretation: The score is an ordinal research rank, not a calibrated probability, target return, or backtested alpha estimate.
hard_gates: Latest attributable earnings and relevant periodic filing independently reviewed; releases and 8-K exhibits are not 10-Qs
No unresolved material accounting or liquidity concern; news allegations are not findings
After a sector liquidation, require at least three completed regular sessions without a new closing low, followed by an orderly hold; this is an analyst risk rule, not a backtested signal
Recheck live valuation, guidance and customer funding before any decision; a lower price or premarket bounce alone cannot pass the gates

position_sizing_overlay.rule: Use the conviction rank only for selection. Size is reduced independently for volatility, portfolio correlation, crowding, customer concentration, liquidity, and earnings risk.
position_sizing_overlay.initial_size: No new position is recommended in this snapshot. If all gates subsequently clear, a staged initial exposure would be no more than one-quarter of intended size, subject to portfolio suitability.
position_sizing_overlay.exit_rule: Review or exit when the guidance, demand, margin, cash-flow, customer, or supply-chain thesis breaks; do not rely on price stops alone.

supply_chain_view.framework: Funded demand -> qualified tools and cleanrooms -> logic and memory -> packaging/test -> networked, powered racks -> useful tokens and customer cash flow
supply_chain_view.forecast_horizon: November 2026 to November 2028; analyst assessment, not a certainty
next_two_year_bottlenecks: Funded demand, customer cash generation and revenue recognition: commitments are not cash collections
Qualified lithography, etch/deposition components and cleanrooms; SEMI survey reports extended lead times, not guaranteed supplier revenue
HBM4/DRAM yield and customer qualification; separate these from a projected 2027 NAND oversupply cycle
Advanced packaging, substrates, known-good devices and high-power / photonic reliability testing
1.6T links, optical packaging, lasers, link reliability and memory-pooling economics; prototypes are not volume wins
Grid connections, transformers, 800V conversion, liquid cooling and powered sites
supply_chain_view.trend: Strong AI demand coexists with funding, governance and commodity-cycle risk. Over 2027-2028 bottlenecks should migrate from devices toward qualified deployment and useful system economics. TrendForce forecasts NAND price declines in 2027; this is a forecast about NAND, not proof that HBM scarcity has ended. Manufacturing complexity can support tool/test content even as later capex cycles reverse. Optical memory pooling and CPO are technology paths, not automatic revenue for every component supplier.

profit_growth_screen.scope: Historical research retained only. Not a current ranking; the user removed the visible section. Current reported figures live in filing_screen.

ten_x_screen.method: Technology adoption -> serviceable market -> durable profit/cash conversion -> dilution-adjusted per-share value. Tenfold price return is a bull-case screen, not a prediction.
selection_rules: Commercial technology with evidence beyond a presentation
Room to expand the company's serviceable market, not just total AI spending
Explicit earnings, share-count and margin hurdles at the current reference price
Funded growth and per-share economics; avoid treating equity-financed cash as operating cash
A non-10x base illustration and severe downside case; no invented success probabilities
ten_x_screen.score_policy: One conviction score only; long-term research is not a separate rating or buy list.
ten_x_screen.return_definition: Share-price return only, before tax, trading costs and dividends; all quotes are October 26 regular-session USD closes.
ten_x_screen.forecast_limits: All 2036 scenarios, terminal shares, P/E, margins and 20% share assumptions are analyst illustrations, not company guidance or calibrated forecasts. Quarter annualization is a scaling reference, not a prediction. Bankruptcy or worse outcomes than the illustrated bear cases remain possible.
